subject.title: feat(feeds): search and follow signed publisher feeds

question: Should OpenClaw core own a durable CLI consumer for arbitrary configured signed publisher feeds, or should this discovery/follow workflow remain in ClawHub or an external plugin until a narrower core seam is agreed?
rationale: The patch creates a new trusted network, configuration, and SQLite persistence surface; repository policy reserves optional discovery integrations for extension boundaries when existing seams suffice, and the supplied context does not establish a maintainer-approved permanent owner boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the core consumer
options.body: Confirm that core should own the signed-feed CLI, shared-state schema, and trust-profile contract, then require upgrade and live workflow proof before merge.

options.title: Route the workflow outward
options.body: Keep only any genuinely generic missing core seam and move publisher discovery/follow behavior to ClawHub or a plugin package.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core consumer
recommendation.body: Confirm that core should own the signed-feed CLI, shared-state schema, and trust-profile contract, then require upgrade and live workflow proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only concrete recent contributor identified in the supplied feed-stack history and can provide the implementation and proof details for a maintainer decision.
